description: Look up a WebAssembly type or type form by name: concrete value types (`i32`, `i64`, `f32`, `f64`, `v128`, `funcref`, `externref`, …) or type forms (`functype`, `limits`, `memtype`, `tabletype`, `globaltype`, `reftype`, `valtype`, `rectype`, `heaptype`, …). Returns its classification, sibling members for category types, defining clause prose, SpecTec formal-rule references, and the rendered spec URL.

name.description: Type or type-form name. Concrete value types: `i32`, `i64`, `f32`, `f64`, `v128`, `funcref`, `externref`, … Type forms: `functype`, `limits`, `memtype`, `tabletype`, `globaltype`, `reftype`, `valtype`, `rectype`, `heaptype`, … Case-insensitive, exact match.

version.description: WebAssembly spec version to query. `latest` (default) is the current served version; `main` is the upstream working draft.

name: type_get
title: Get type
